title: Account Executive I/II, Parkinson's Disease - Knoxville, TN
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Candidates will be hired at a level commensurate with their experience; this role will be filled at either grade 18 or grade 19. This field-based role will cover Knoxville, Johnson City, and Bristol, Tennessee, as well as Asheville, North Carolina.
The Parkinson’s Disease (PD) Account Executive (AE) is responsible for maximizing business opportunities with approved on-market products (drug device combination) for the Parkinson’s Franchise. The PD AE will develop and maintain strategic business relationships with accounts through interactions with approved Movement Disorder Specialists, Neurologists, Advance Practice Providers, Health Care Professionals, nurses, executive level personnel, department managers, and various other support staff. Business relationships will focus on increasing education on product benefits/risks and awareness of current therapeutic gaps, consistent with approved labels, developing new business and expand current business, maximizing resource utilization, and increasing sales aimed at achieving sales plan for the assigned Parkinson’s product portfolio. The PD AE will also focus on building and maintaining successful and compliant working relationships with Parkinson’s Advocacy, Support groups, and other groups that support Parkinson’s patients.
Key Job Responsibilities:
Delivers effective on-label technical and scientific presentations/sales calls utilizing approved data and resources to appropriately highlight the benefits and risks of the product and create awareness of product solution addressing gap in therapeutic area - resulting in sales quota achievement.
Leverages opportunities to understand and address customer needs. Builds and maintains relationships across accounts that result in opportunities to benefit patients and HCPs.  Consistently partners with AbbVie in-field and in-house teams to identify, design and/or adapt appropriate approaches and tactics.
Serve as lead US Commercial contact with targeted accounts in assigned geography. Appropriately and compliantly addresses needs of customer and patients through expert knowledge of AbbVie’s environment of care approach.
Creates, implements and communicates strategic and tactical plans for targeted accounts. Monitor and report sales progress. Provide routine communications to all internal and external (as applicable) stakeholders.
Attend and actively participate in local neurology society meetings, conferences, patient programs, support groups, advocacy events, etc., some of which occur in the evenings or weekends. Represent AbbVie and assigned products at such venues to build or enhance relationships and education on product, increasing awareness. Channel key information, developments or findings to internal partners/stakeholders. All attendance and communications in these forums are within OEC and Legal guidance with all product discussions on-label.
Based on individual accounts, customers and geographical dynamics, create and development business strategy, territory account plans, align appropriate resources to support tactic execution and adjust as needed.
Remain current on all clinical, market, and payer developments, trends, and issues specific to Parkinson’s Disease.
Complete all AbbVie required training and maintain adherence to all company policies and OEC/Legal procedures.
An essential requirement of your position is to meet health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements for entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.
Represent AbbVie as a partner of choice in the Parkinson’s and Neuroscience space with HCP and Patient Organizations
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Bachelor's degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Minimum 2 years sales or account management experience.
3+ Years of Health Science Field or Sales experience with a minimum of 2 years in pharmaceutical sales. In lieu of degree 8+ Years of Health Science Sales experience with minimum of 4 years in pharmaceutical sales.
Demonstrated ability to network and partner effectively across functional areas.
Excellent organizational/project management and demonstrated leadership skills.
Proven record of managing multiple stakeholders in complex environments.
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements & for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.

Enables higher performance by building and maintaining strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team.
Identifies potential improvements to the program; remains flexible, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement on enrichment and operant conditioning related strategies. Embraces the ideas of others, nurtures innovation and assists with the progression of innovation to reality.
Assists with daily tasks associated with animal enrichment animal enrichment, such as scheduling, prep, distribution to animals, evaluation of effectiveness, and enrichment area/supply maintenance.

Works with moderate work direction, remains flexible, performs multiple projects simultaneously, meets deadlines, and maintains sanitation standards.
Assists with incorporating the 3R’s into the Behavioral Management program
Attends applicable training and workshops pertaining to lab animal enrichment/behavior; participates in on-site enrichment trainings and committees where required.
Provides animal husbandry duties as required; Required weekend husbandry (or animal enrichment/ operant conditioning) rotation commitment
High School/GED is required AND at least 3 years prior technical experience in laboratory animal science setting OR relevant degree in related discipline (biology, animal behavior, animal science, veterinary technology) with at least two years laboratory animal science experience.
At least two years of animal husbandry/enrichment/ behavior/ training experience.
Certification by the American Association for Laboratory Animal Science (AALAS) at the Assistant Laboratory Animal Technician (ALAT) level; eligibility for LAT certification
Knowledge of basic regulatory requirements.
Communication Skills – Ability to concisely communicate key issues to stakeholders.
Analytical Skills – Ability to assess issues that arise, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information as needed, and identify key issues that need to be addressed.
Computer Literacy – Basic competence of spreadsheets, word processing and email, and knowledge of computerized maintenance management systems and purchasing systems.

The Associate Director, Quality Change Management is the strategic leader for R&D Quality Change Management within AbbVie’s Global Quality Systems team. This role drives enterprise-wide standardization and excellence by providing expert oversight and promoting proactive identification, communication, implementation, and governance of change in alignment with global regulatory requirements and industry standards. The Associate Director also leads the QCM Quality System Network, comprising subject matter experts and change practitioners across R&D.
Responsibilities :
The Associate Director, Quality Change Management is responsible to:
Serve as the strategic owner and leader of the global R&D Quality Change Management (QCM) system, driving sustainable excellence and compliance across functions.
Design, develop, and continuously improve quality systems, standards, practices, and supporting tools, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory and industry expectations.
Establish and maintain robust governance structures for QCM, ensuring changes are consistently identified, assessed, approved, implemented, communicated, and monitored in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
Champion and harmonize QCM processes, documentation, and standards across R&D to achieve consistency and operational alignment.
Lead and mentor a global network of QCM subject matter experts (SMEs) and practitioners, fostering an enterprise-wide culture of knowledge-sharing, collaboration, and best practice adoption.
Act as the primary consultant and advisor to internal R&D stakeholders, providing QCM guidance, regulatory updates, issue resolution, and process implementation support.
Oversee the creation, maintenance, and harmonization of process documentation, SOPs, and training materials to ensure effective knowledge transfer and compliance.
Define, monitor, and report on key quality and risk metrics, using data-driven insights to inform leadership, drive continuous improvement, and ensure accountability.
Ensure organization-wide inspection readiness; represent the company during Health Authority inspections, including responding to and defending QCM practices and policies.
Proactively monitor and influence external regulatory trends and industry standards, advocating for the organization and elevating QCM maturity at both the company and industry level.
Qualifications :
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a scientific discipline, life sciences, engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 8 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (or 5+ years with an MS/PhD), with relevant focus in quality change management.
Proven leadership experience in matrixed, cross-functional environments, with demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
Extensive hands-on experience in Quality Change Management (QCM), covering multiple domains such as Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, pre-Clinical, or Manufacturing.
Deep knowledge of global regulatory frameworks, inspection readiness, compliance standards, and QCM methodologies
Demonstrated capability to standardize and scale quality and change management processes globally to enhance operational efficiency and reduce complexity.
Strong change agility, with a track record of effectively leading organizations through ambiguity and transformation while balancing competing priorities.
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and mentoring skills, including experience engaging with senior leadership and developing SMEs.

title: Associate Director, Global Aesthetics Business Development Forecasting & Analytics
description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Associate Director, Global Aesthetics Business Development Forecasting & Analytics leads forecasting and analytical evaluation for external innovation and business development opportunities across the Global Aesthetics portfolio. This highly visible role partners across Business Development, Pipeline Commercialization & Strategy, Finance, R&D, Marketing, Market Research, and regional teams to assess commercial potential, inform investment decisions, and translate strategic opportunities into clear financial value.
Roles and responsibilities
Lead forecasting and analytics for business development opportunities across Global Aesthetics, including external innovation, licensing, partnership, acquisition, and portfolio expansion opportunities within Facial, Plastics/Regen Med, Body Contouring, and Skin Care franchises.
Develop robust, assumption-driven forecasts that size market opportunities, quantify commercial potential, assess scenario risk, and translate business development strategy into clear financial value.
Partner closely with Business Development, PCS marketing, market research, Finance, R&D, regional marketing, and operations teams to evaluate strategic fit, commercial viability, launch potential, and long-range value creation for new assets and external opportunities.
Create forecasts and analytical outputs to support governance decisions, diligence milestones, and investment prioritization.  Develop and present clear, evidence-based recommendations to senior leaders, articulating commercial potential, key assumptions, risks and strategic trade-offs.
Synthesize insights and deliver recommendations for business development deals, pipeline assets, and new clinical programs.
Leverage market research, competitive intelligence, analog analysis, claims/positioning assumptions, epidemiology or procedure trends, pricing, access, and adoption dynamics to inform business development forecasting assumptions.
Manage the end-to-end forecasting process for business development opportunities, including input coordination, scenario development, stakeholder reviews, alignment discussions, sensitivity analysis, and submission-ready forecast deliverables.
Drive alignment with financial leadership to ensure business development forecasts, valuation inputs, risks, opportunities, and strategic narrative are integrated into the overall Global Aesthetics franchise view.
Lead analytical support for cross-functional assessments of external innovation, white-space opportunities, portfolio gaps, and strategic growth initiatives across franchises.
Scope:

Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, statisticians, statistical programmers, and AI specialists in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences, focused on transforming clinical trial surveillance through AI-enabled data integration, analytics, and automated reporting. TSA delivers integrated medical monitoring and safety surveillance capabilities that enable timely, trusted, and actionable insights across the clinical development lifecycle.
Data Scientists play a key role in designing, developing, and scaling innovative analytics solutions that support clinical trial surveillance, medical monitoring, safety evaluation, and data-driven decision-making. This position combines analytical expertise, business acumen, and modern AI-enabled approaches to transform complex clinical data into meaningful insights that improve operational efficiency and support patient safety. The team is AI-native: agentic coding and AI tools are part of how we program, analyze, and report.
Responsibilities:
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand surveillance, analytics, and reporting needs and translate them into scalable, fit-for-purpose solutions.
Develop analytical products, automated workflows, and AI-enabled capabilities that support trial surveillance, medical monitoring, and safety assessment activities, including streamlined solutions from data to analytics to reporting.
Apply statistical methodologies, machine learning techniques, and advanced analytics approaches to generate actionable insights from clinical trial data.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of integrated analytics platforms, data pipelines, and reporting solutions that support ongoing monitoring and safety surveillance.
Transform complex clinical and operational data into clear visualizations, decision-support tools, and meaningful business insights for clinical and safety teams.
Apply AI to transform statistical programming: use agentic coding and generative AI to generate, validate, and document code and outputs, contribute to migrating legacy SAS programs to R, and measure resulting efficiency gains.
Collaborate with team members to establish best practices, reusable analytical assets, and standards that ensure high-quality and consistent user experiences.
Support continuous innovation through experimentation, proof-of-concept development, and evaluation of emerging analytical and AI technologies.
Contribute to operational excellence initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality and reporting efficiency.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GCP, ICH guidelines, AbbVie policies, and departmental quality standards.

Bachelor’s degree statistics, analytics, bioinformatics, data science or equivalent field.

Complete or Full / Career proficiency in R, Python or other statistical languages and packages.
Intermediate-level knowledge of statistical and data mining techniques.
Intermediate proficiency with visualization tools such as Spotfire, PyDash/Plotly, or equivalent platforms.
Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or generative AI technologies to business problems.
Experience developing automated reporting, data products, or end-to-end analytical solutions.

Familiarity with clinical data standards (e.g., CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and clinical development processes preferred.

The role leads cross-functional collaboration to ensure data strategies, standards, and technologies are consistently embedded into clinical plans, while translating complex data and technology concepts into actionable decisions for the study team. Through strong project management, risk oversight, and continuous process optimization, the Data Strategy Lead is key to ensuring successful clinical trial technology delivery.​

​​Serves as the CDSO study start-up subject matter expert and single point of contact for assigned studies, owning all data-related start-up deliverables from protocol development through system go-live.
​Leads data management study start-up end-to-end, partnering both within CDSO and across the study team to enable on-time study start. Leverages operational analytics and project management tools to optimize execution, track progress, and escalate and resolve issues affecting timelines or quality.
​Ensures consistency in data strategy, standards, CRFs, and surveillance approaches across studies and therapeutic area(s). Translates complex data, technology, and standards concepts into clear, decision-ready guidance for study teams.
​Drives the pull-through of critical-to-quality factors and data criticality assessments, ensuring they are translated and implemented into downstream data systems.
​Ensures adherence to federal and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie SOPs, and functional quality standards; stays abreast of evolving guidance.
​Influences without direct authority, using data and evidence to drive aligned, mutually beneficial outcomes for AbbVie.
​Leads CDSO innovation and process improvement initiatives and participates in cross-functional initiatives.
​Responsible for coaching and mentoring team members.​
This role is a hybrid role with 3 days a week onsite.
Bachelor’s degree in business, management information systems, computer science, life sciences or equivalent. Master’s preferred. PMP Certification or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt desired.

Frequent contact with all levels of management and corporate personnel to include:  Sr. Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, Associate Vice Presidents, Heads of Sales, Area Sales Directors, District Sales Managers, Facial Aesthetics Sales Representatives, Inside Sales Representatives, Marketing Directors, Product Managers, Human Resources, R&D, and Sales and Marketing Managers from other divisions.
Additional contacts with VIP customers which include HCP course faculty.
Main point of contact for outside vendors related to training and meeting engagement technology.
Bachelors degree, (MBA preferred)
A thorough knowledge of Clinical and Business Development in the Aesthetics industry including strong knowledge of practitioners, retail and sales and marketing practices.  This level of knowledge would normally require a minimum 15+ years of related experience (sales and/or sales leadership, training and marketing) in the Aesthetics and or Pharmaceutical/Medical Device market.

Clear understanding of navigating and Aesthetics business and experience rolling out programs involving point of sales, patient consultation, patient recruitment and patient rewards programs and a minimum of 4 to 6 years of executing these programs.

Minimum of 8+ years of sales training, business training and/or training leadership experience in Aesthetics or Pharmaceutical/Medical Device
Minimum of 5+ years leading leaders of teams to achieve training, sales or marketing objectives.
Marketing Experience in Aesthetics, Medical Device or Pharmaceuticals is preferred but not required

Ability to develop a vision, mission and purpose with a cross functional team to achieve results across multiple objectives and workstreams.
Excellent cross-functional partnership skills and ability to work effectively to drive alignment in a matrix organization.
Strong leadership skills to direct the effective development of entry level to Sr. level skills across the sales organization.
Excellent communication skills, oral and written at a senior leadership level.  The ability to present to various levels and sizes of groups within and outside of the organization.
Proven managerial skills and the ability to work effectively with and through others especially under project and meeting deadlines.
Strong to exceptional planning and project management skills.
Strong analytical skills and a good working knowledge of sales and marketing plans and controls as well as solid computer skills.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The MSL/Senior MSL:
A field based scientific expert that strategically supports the research and business objectives of a designated therapeutic area across the product life cycle for a specific geography/territory
The primary communicator of AbbVie science within a specific geography with healthcare professionals.
Develops and maintains professional relationships with internal and external customers to provide comprehensive medical and scientific support to AbbVie initiatives in assigned therapeutic areas.
Viewed as a peer scientific expert in a designated therapeutic area/product.
Combined with strong strategic vision, market therapeutic area awareness, as well as clinical expertise, the MSL/Senior MSL serve as a conduit of information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding current and future therapies in development or commercialized by AbbVie.
The MSL/Senior MSL works closely with other AbbVie personnel to ensure information, education, and research needs of healthcare professionals are met and to ensure scientific and technical training needs of commercial organizations are identified and met.
Responsibilities:
Identify, develop, and maintain professional relationships with thought leaders, academic centers, and researchers in assigned areas of therapeutic interest to ensure access to current medical and scientific information on the designated therapeutic/product area
Present scientific information and education relative to disease state, therapeutic landscape, and AbbVie products across the product lifecycle to healthcare professionals including physicians, academic institutions, researchers, and other health care professionals.
Support research initiatives as requested by AbbVie R&D, Clinical Operations, and Medical Affairs Departments and physician-initiated projects including, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.
Prepares marketplace in new therapeutic areas of interest, which includes creating awareness and relationships for AbbVie in the Medical community.
Creates, maintains, and collaborates in relationships with internal cross-functional partnerships, Works with in-field commercial teams, as appropriate, to develop and execute Account plans designed to support and meet shared business objectives. Serves as a scientific resource to commercial partners, as appropriate, to support activities
Serve as a medical/scientific resource to healthcare providers through answering unsolicited medical questions and addressing other clinically related medical information issues.
Support and provide Conduct on-going training to medical affairs, field sales and other internal personnel as directed.
Practices core capabilities in strategic segmentation, as well as optimal resource utilization.
Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and Procedure, including accurate and timely documentation as it relates to HCP (Healthcare Professionals) interactions. Responsible for maintaining annual expenses within assigned budget parameters.
Advanced degree required (i.e., Pharm D, MD/DO, PhD, APP (i.e.: Physician Associate or Nurse Practitioner) in a relevant scientific discipline. Doctorate strongly preferred in a health science or clinical discipline.
Typically requires a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience for a Senior MSL
Typically requires a minimum of 0-2 years of relevant experience for an MSL
Must be able to identify, analyze, and translate specific territory and corporate needs to support internal and external customers and achieve business and clinical objectives.
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Power Point, and other software skills; Excellent written/verbal communication skills;
Strong interpersonal skills, presentation, and teaching skills; Ability to work independently and in a team structure; Ability to adjust effectively to work within new structures, processes, requirements, or cultures; Strong planning and organizational skills; team and leadership skills
An essential requirement of the position is to meet health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to enter facilities and organizations in your assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.
Ability to learn and convey clinical and non-clinical technical information effectively
Ability to engage the audience and help them understand and retain information
Must be willing to travel up to 75% of the time.

Upstate NY, Western and Central PA

title: Principal Research Scientist
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.
Key Competencies
Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.
Preferred Experience
Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
Experience working in agile product development environments.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.
Key Competencies
Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.
Preferred Experience
Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
Experience working in agile product development environments.

AbbVie is seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our Analytics & AI organization and help advance the next generation of Copay Intelligence capabilities.
This role will focus on developing innovative machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that help identify complex reimbursement and affordability program dynamics, improve patient access insights, and drive more proactive decision-making across patient support programs.
The successful candidate will play a key role in building predictive intelligence products that leverage healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data to identify emerging opportunities, uncover hidden patterns, and generate actionable recommendations. The Senior Data Scientist will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of advanced analytics and AI solutions supporting AbbVie's Copay Intelligence initiatives. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving challenging problems with data and enjoys working across the full lifecycle of AI and machine learning product development.

AI & Machine Learning Development
Develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.
Build predictive models that identify patterns, risks, and opportunities from healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data.

Develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.

Design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
Implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
Support development of enterprise AI products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
Ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.

Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
Serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
Present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.

6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.

Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

Experience using modern software development and version control practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of AI technologies.

Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, payer, patient support, or market access data.
Experience developing AI-powered decision support systems.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

title: Senior Manager, Trial Surveillance & Analytics (Hybrid)
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a newly formed center of excellence in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences organization. Our mission is to transform how AbbVie conducts ongoing clinical trial surveillance — integrating trial data, analytics and AI so that study teams and patient safety colleagues see emerging safety and efficacy signals early, and can act on them with confidence. This is work upstream, inside ongoing clinical trials, where insight can still change decisions for the study and for patients.
The Senior Manager, Trial Surveillance & Analytics is a hands-on, full-stack data scientist who takes a surveillance question from intake to a working solution. You will work in a small team that owns a capability end to end — from the data, through the analysis, to the tool that study teams use — and you will own your solutions from problem statement to a working product that people use. The team is AI-native from day one: agentic coding and AI agents are part of how we work, with room to experiment and to scale what works. You will combine depth in one area (such as statistical programming and reporting, data integration, data visualization, data science and machine learning, or data and software engineering) with enough breadth across clinical data, analytics and AI to deliver on your own, with the support of the team. As an early member of a new center of excellence, you will help define how it works, the standards it sets and the capabilities it builds, partnering across Global Patient Safety, therapeutic area clinical development teams, Statistics, Statistical Programming and data engineering across the portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Frame surveillance problems with stakeholders before building: understand the decision to be supported, design for adoption, and iterate with users.
Design and build data pipelines and analysis-ready, integrated data on SDTM, ADaM and integrated databases to support safety and efficacy surveillance.
Lead blinded, standardized analytics across studies and compounds to detect emerging safety and efficacy signals early.
Deliver reporting — tables, listings and figures, safety reports and listings — and automate it wherever possible.
Develop applications, dashboards and self-service tools that study teams and patient safety colleagues use themselves; drive their adoption and measure their use.
Apply generative and agentic AI across the analysis workflow, build AI agents on the clinical data foundation, and measure the gain in time and quality.
Integrate clinical trial and real-world data where the science requires it, assessing comparability and data quality first.
Lead projects and small cross-functional pods; coach and mentor team members. May include indirect supervision of employees and contract staff.
Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate technical concepts and results clearly to non-technical audiences.
Ensure adherence to applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and functional quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 8+ years of experience) or PhD (with 4+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Machine learning and AI or a highly related field.
Experience may be in pharmaceutical, biotech, health technology or related industries.
Strong hands-on programming in R and Python, plus SQL and version control (e.g. Git), with a track record of writing production-quality code for end-to-end analytical pipelines.
Demonstrated experience applying generative or agentic AI to analytical or programming work, with measurable results.
Experience working with clinical trial data (e.g. CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and/or real-world data (e.g. EHR, claims, registries).
A track record of building analytical tools or solutions that were adopted and sustained by their users.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts in plain language and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing and building agentic AI systems (e.g. multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval and evaluation), with a track record of solutions delivered and used in production.
Experience in clinical development, drug safety, pharmacovigilance, clinical trial monitoring or regulatory evidence generation.
Knowledge of clinical trial design and of methods for real-world evidence, such as cohort definition, confounding control and external comparators.
Experience building interactive visualizations and data apps with modern frameworks (e.g. Plotly / Dash, Streamlit, Shiny, React / D3) and deploying on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS).
Familiarity with SAS.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives; formal business or leadership training is a plus.
Publications, presentations or community leadership in data science, statistics or AI.

description:
Job Description
The Opportunity
Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices.
This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time.
What you'll do
Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web.
Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience.
Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure.
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process.
Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment.
Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them.
Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding.
Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale.
Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering.

Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production.
Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier.
Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms.
Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows.
Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products.

You will ensure alignment with SOX, ITAC, and ITGC requirements and support business objectives. This position works closely with internal and external auditors to maintain audit readiness, manage evidence, and lead timely remediation of control gaps across the transformation portfolio.
In this position, you can help guide Adobe’s finance operations as they scale and transform, while developing a risk and controls framework that fosters growth and innovation.

Act as the expert authority on financial reporting risks, IT Application Controls (ITACs), and IT General Controls (ITGCs for initiatives across the CAO organization

Build and Scale the Risk & Controls Function

Define the operating model, processes, tools, and governance required to scale risk coverage as the portfolio grows.
Recruit, develop, and mentor team members, creating clear development paths and a strong culture of accountability and partnership.
Program & Collaborator Management
Manage a portfolio of risk/controls workstreams while multiple optimization and transformation activities take place.
Define and track important metrics for control health, audit findings, and remediation timelines.
Build strong relationships across Finance, Technology, Internal Audit, and Transformation teams to drive a proactive risk management mindset.
Develop and communicate knowledge through written correspondence and verbal presentations.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
When a significant severe safety incident impacts, or threatens to impact, our community or company, the Community Crisis Management (CCM) team works to coordinate a swift and effective response across the company to mitigate any continued damage. The team is responsible and accountable for immediate decisions, managing the cross-functional response to severe safety crises on the platform, keeping Airbnb leadership properly informed and involved, and for alerting relevant team leaders to any root causes or vulnerabilities that may have been uncovered throughout the response.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Community Crisis Investigator, you carry your own caseload and run the day-to-day response, with a defined check-in point for the calls that set precedent or carry external exposure. You assess incidents and bring what you learn back to the team.
A Typical Day:
Crisis Case Work
Assess incoming incidents and recommend whether a case meets the threshold for crisis implementation, drafting summaries concise and comprehensive enough that the decision-maker can act on them without sending them back.
Outline and drive the case management actions needed for stakeholders to respond effectively, keeping the response moving inside the incident’s timeline.
Research case precedent and consult stakeholders when a case does not fit an established pattern, and bring your recommended option with its reasoning rather than an open question.
Prepare concise overviews and next steps for urgent, monitoring, or implemented cases, and note team updates or housekeeping items during regional check-ins.
Communication and Stakeholder Management
Draft crisis case communication for senior stakeholders, and supply the case detail and assessment that executive notifications are built from.
Keep stakeholders and GCM (Global Crisis Management) leadership current on case status proactively, before they ask.
Hold day-to-day communication with your assigned cross-functional partners: maintain regular contact, come prepared to the agenda, and bring what you learn back to the global GCM team.
Systemic Improvement
Flag where policy, product, or process failed the community member, with enough specificity that the owning team can act. The goal is closing the gap that allowed the incident, not only resolving the incident.
Keep the case management tool accurate for your own cases and raise data or backlog problems you notice, so the team’s view of the global caseload stays trustworthy.
Team Contribution
Review peers’ assessments as a second pair of eyes before submission, checking for errors, missing stakeholders, and recommendations worth adding.
Share what you learn from your cases and stakeholder relationships with the team.
Contribute to team culture and to a working environment where people can do this work sustainably.
Operational Rigor
Maintain case documentation and trackers to a standard that supports accurate analytics and clean handoffs within and across regions.
Complete work within the dedicated SLAs, and raise it early when a case is at risk of slipping rather than after it has.

6+ years of experience in customer support or front-line work handling escalated, sensitive cases, including crisis or survivor-facing work such as a crisis line, victim advocacy, emergency response, or trust and safety.

Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Distribution Partnerships team’s mission is taking Airbnb out to the world; working with a range of partners to embed Airbnb in highly trusted and contextually relevant environments to meet guests where they already plan and book their travel, experiences, and services.
The team owns partnerships end to end, from initial ideation, strategy, engagement, and agreement through product launch and ongoing relationship management. BD works hand in hand with Partner Management, which grows, measures, and continuously improves each partnership after launch. This role owns partner management for a portfolio of live distribution partners, with approximately 70% of time on day-to-day management and strategic development of existing partners and 30% supporting the team on new partners and renewals, and is growing to become an end to end partnerships leader.
The Difference You Will Make:
We are looking for an experienced, proactive Senior Partnerships Manager to join our Distribution Partnerships team, reporting to the Director, Distribution Partnerships.  You will manage a portfolio of live distribution partners across our verticals, such as financial services, airlines and loyalty programs, and business travel platforms (the mix may change as priorities shift), and support new partner deals and renewals as you grow into the role.
In the future, you will have an opportunity to contribute to the distribution strategy, help define which segments and partners to target, and support negotiations and deal structuring on individual partnerships. You will carry each deal through launch and into long-term growth, establishing the measurement, forecasting, and feedback loops that let the wider team scale the program globally.
Our partnerships are powered by a portfolio of products that are still being built (embedded booking, points earn and pay with points, embeds, and a partner portal), so you will work closely with Product and Engineering on what partners need and what we can ship. This is a highly cross-functional, high-ambiguity individual-contributor role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, product, dealmaking, and partner development, and who can build a business from zero to one and one to ten with limited guidance. The role also includes project management and operations, often where processes are not yet defined, so we need someone scrappy and proactive who finds ways to unblock problems we have not identified yet.
A Typical Day:
Partner management. Own the day-to-day relationship with your partners. Run regular partner reviews and QBRs, review funnels, track performance against targets (bookings, revenue, conversion), resolve escalations, and give early warning on at-risk partners. Success is measured by revenue growth and conversion improvement across your portfolio. Keep a feedback loop between partners and Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to shape the roadmap.
Partnership strategy. Contribute to and execute the BD strategy for your partner categories, within the wider distribution strategy. Identify the highest-value partners and use cases, and bring a clear, well-supported point of view on how each category should grow, including commercial models, incentive structures, and the sequencing of partners needed to prove and scale it.

Support the BD process for new partners and renewals, and progressively lead it on priority partnerships, from initial outreach and scoping through needs assessment, negotiation, term sheet, and contract execution. Launch and ongoing growth. Lead each partnership through launch, then own ongoing performance. Set launch plans with Product and Marketing, track performance against targets, and optimize offers, placements, and experiences to grow results over the lifecycle of the partnership.

Cross-functional leadership. Work closely with Finance, Legal, Product, Engineering, Payments, and Marketing to define partner requirements, model revenue opportunities, set success metrics, and develop contracting frameworks. Anticipate partner needs, build consensus, and represent the opportunity clearly to senior internal stakeholders so priority deals move quickly.
Market and category expertise. Build deep expertise in the partner landscapes relevant to your categories. Monitor competitor activity and market shifts, including how other travel marketplaces approach B2B distribution, and bring well-developed recommendations to leadership.
Program development. Capture learnings from early launches to build the playbooks, commercial templates, and partner onboarding processes that allow these categories to scale globally.

Experience managing a portfolio of live strategic partners and growing their performance over time through relationship development, partner business insights and expertise, funnel analysis, regular business reviews, and ongoing optimization of offers, placements, and experiences
Ability to spot at-risk partnerships early, work through escalations, and build trusted, long-term relationships with partner teams at every level
Experience managing or building partnership programs from scratch, including defining strategy, recruiting early partners, and developing commercial frameworks
Strong commercial instincts and experience structuring and negotiating deals with diverse partner types, including referral, revenue-share, and loyalty or rewards models
Strong analytical mindset; able to build ROI models and forecasts, use data to identify underlying trends, and make informed decisions. Comfort with Excel, Google Sheets, and AI tools

Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with limited precedent; able to make sound decisions with incomplete information and flourish with minimal guidance
Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Marketing to align on strategy and move deals forward
Exceptional communication, presentation, and influence skills; able to develop a compelling point of view and bring senior stakeholders along
Ability to manage complex projects and operations, and to build process where none exists, while attending to both details and macro-level outcomes

We are building a new generation of AI-native products to fundamentally change how Amazon identifies, understands, and eliminates the problems that create friction for selling partners. This is an opportunity to apply Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, and agentic AI to one of Amazon’s most complex problems: turning millions of fragmented seller signals into actionable intelligence and systematically eliminating the root causes behind them.
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Tech to lead a strategic AI initiative focused on reducing the need for selling partners WW to contact Amazon by systematically identifying and eliminating the root causes of seller friction. The initiative, Root Cause Elimination (RCE), will build an intelligent, end-to-end system that brings together seller signals across contacts, escalations, audits, and other mechanisms and uses AI to generate insights, identify and consolidate root causes, quantify and prioritize their impact, recommend preventive actions, and continuously validate whether those interventions eliminated the underlying seller problem. The vision is to move from teams manually finding and reacting to individual defects to an intelligent system that continuously learns from seller experiences and helps Amazon prevent those experiences from recurring.
From Day 1, this leader will have ownership of a large, ambiguous product space and the autonomy to define the product vision, AI strategy, technical roadmap, and customer experience. You will partner deeply with Engineering and Science to define LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, machine-learning models, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and AI evaluation frameworks, while building experiences that enable Policy and Program teams to turn AI-generated intelligence into action. You will make high-judgment decisions about where AI can automate work, where human judgment should remain in the loop, and how the system earns trust as it scales globally.
The Senior Product Manager-Tech will be a bar-raising product leader and communicator who thrives at the intersection of AI, technology, and complex business problems. This role requires the ability to clearly articulate complex problems and solutions, align teams toward clear priorities, advocate for investment, and establish mechanisms that measure progress against shared goals. You will collaborate across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations, Policy, and Program teams and influence leaders across multiple VP-level organizations.
This is a global role with significant interaction with teams outside the United States and the opportunity to build a product from its earliest stages. The decisions made in this role will directly shape the experience of selling partners, how Amazon uses AI to identify and eliminate systemic seller defects, and our ability to build seller trust at scale. title: Hardware System Integration Electrical Engineer - Mac
description:
MacBook Air design requires thousands of engineering decisions that balance performance, battery life, thermals, reliability, manufacturability, and industrial design. We’re looking for talented System EEs who enjoy solving complex system-level tradeoffs and turning ambitious product concepts into products used by millions of people worldwide.
In this role, you will own key aspects of electrical system design and integration, defining, designing, and validating the electrical subsystems that differentiate MacBook Air. You'll collaborate closely with experts from mechanical engineering, Apple Silicon, software, and module technology teams to deliver industry-leading products.
You'll apply your expertise in computer system architecture, circuit design, power delivery, high-speed interfaces, and PCB design to solve some of the industry's most challenging system integration problems—all while maximizing performance, battery life, reliability, and user experience within one of the world's most space-constrained consumer products.

Experience with schematic capture and constraint-driven PCB design using Cadence Allegro/OrCAD or equivalent EDA tools.
Experience with numerical modeling, simulation, and analysis tools, including SPICE, 2D/3D field solvers, and power and signal integrity analysis.
Experience with data analysis, visualization, and scripting to automate validation, debug, and engineering workflows.
Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Intellectually curious, creative, collaborative, and passionate about solving challenging engineering problems and continuously learning.
Preferred qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with industry-level practical experience.
Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, including analog and digital circuit theory, signal integrity, and power integrity.
Experience in circuit design in one or more areas, including power, digital, analog, high-speed interfaces, programmable logic, or wireless systems.
Strong PCB layout expertise spanning constrained multilayer designs, high-speed interfaces, power delivery networks, flex circuits, and cable assemblies. Proficiency with Allegro or equivalent PCB design tools.
Experience with electrical validation and debug using high-speed oscilloscopes, vector network analyzers, BERTs, and protocol analyzers.

description:
Join Apple's HID sensing and interaction algorithms team, which develops advanced sensing algorithms that enable best-in-class user experiences across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, and exciting new products. We are looking for a machine learning engineer with hands-on generative AI experience and a strong foundation in signal processing, who is excited to apply both to how people interact with Apple products.
Our team draws from diverse backgrounds: signal processing, machine learning, firmware, software engineering, physics, human factors, and more; all dedicated to inventing new ways users interact with Apple products. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and design, collaborating with specialists across Apple to ship extraordinary products to millions of users every year.
In this role, you will help explore how generative AI can advance sensing and interaction. You will research, develop, and evaluate generative models and AI systems for physical signals such as time series and images. Success here is measured by real-world impact on products and users, not by leaderboard numbers. That takes a deep understanding of the signals you model and statistical rigor in how you judge results. These are challenging, open-ended problems, and we are looking for someone with the persistence to carry an idea all the way into production.

title: SOC Design Verification Engineer
description:
Apple’s wireless chip powers connectivity across every new iPhone — and its successor is already taking shape. Would you like to join Apple’s growing wireless silicon development team? Our wireless SOC organization owns every aspect of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. It is driven by a world-class, vertically integrated team spanning RF/Analog, Systems/PHY/MAC, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. As a Wireless SOC Design Verification Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of the chip design effort — owning a meaningful verification scope and growing it project to project.
You’ll be responsible for pre-silicon RTL verification at the block, subsystem, and top-level SOC, taking your scope from test planning through coverage closure and signoff. Working closely with architects, designers, and firmware engineers, you’ll build reusable testbenches and verification environments using modern, metric-driven methodology. Areas you may work on include the Power Management Unit, CPU subsystem, DMA, on-chip debug infrastructure, PCIe, bus fabric, boot and secure-boot sequencing, MAC-PHY Verification, Radio integration, and peripherals such as SPI — choosing simulation, formal, or whichever approach the design actually calls for. Low power is part of your scope wherever it shows up: you’ll verify power intent using UPF within your area.
Over time, you can grow deeper into the IPs and subsystems you know best, or broader — across IPs and up from block level to full SOC integration. The team is also pushing hard on AI-assisted verification, and you’ll help figure out where it fits best: test generation, debug, coverage closure, or all the above.
Minimum qualifications: Minimum requirement of a bachelors degree.
Hands-on experience across the verification cycle: test planning, testbench implementation, test creation and debug, and coverage closure.
Strong SystemVerilog and Verilog skills, with solid working knowledge of UVM.
Solid problem-solving and debugging skills with constrained-random verification.
Understanding of digital logic design, SOC architecture, and microarchitecture.
Preferred qualifications: Experience taking at least one ASIC/SOC from concept through tape-out.
Verification experience with PCIe, bus fabric/NOC, or AHB/AXI-based architectures in a UVM environment.
Experience verifying IP or top-level integration for a WiFi or Bluetooth SOC, or knowledge of wireless protocols.
Experience with low-power verification, UPF, boot-up, power-cycling, and HW/FW interaction.
Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and/or formal tools (e.g., JasperGold).
Experience defining coverage space and writing coverage models.
Experience with embedded CPU verification; programming in C/C++ or assembly.
