Support management of indirect tax audits and other indirect tax matters involving tax authorities internationally

An advanced degree

Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment

About the team
The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.
What you’ll do
Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.
We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.
Responsibilities
Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts
Preferred qualifications
Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams

description:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. Identify and prioritize vertical feature investments across Remix modules, with the rigor to make each one best in class rather than broadly adequate

Work closely with data science and engineering to define how AI and analytics capabilities are surfaced in the product — what insights matter, when they appear, and how they drive action
Engage directly with customers to understand workflow pain points, validate priorities, and pressure-test the roadmap against real operational needs
Stay current on industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technology to ensure Remix leads rather than follows

You are a big-picture thinker who can articulate a multi-year platform vision while also making sharp, well-reasoned prioritization calls at the feature level

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, ML Training Performance
description:
Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and ground-up build autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. We are still in the early stages of deploying our robotaxis on public roads, and it is a great time to join Zoox and have a significant impact in executing this mission. You will get to work with SOTA accelerators, cutting-edge techniques in distributed training, quantization, distillation, and pruning, among other things, working closely with all the Autonomy teams within Zoox - Perception, Prediction, Planner, Simulation, Collision Avoidance, and have the opportunity to significantly push the boundaries of how ML is practiced within Zoox.   We build and operate the base layer of ML tools, model development, and serving systems that our applied research teams use for in- and off-vehicle ML use cases. You will work alongside a team of strong software engineers and act as a force multiplier for our internal customers. This team has many growth opportunities as we expand our robotaxi deployments and venture into new ML domains. If you want to learn more about our stack behind autonomous driving, please look here. If you want to learn more about our ML Infrastructure, here is one of our past talks at re:Invent. In this role, you will:
  • Lead the design, implementation, and operation of training performance optimizations (data/tensor/pipeline parallelism, mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, GPU kernels) to scale VLM, VLA, and Foundation model training.
  • Own the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for RL framework and RL performance optimization for driving foundation models.
  • Drive profiling and root-cause analysis of throughput bottlenecks across the compute, compiler, framework, and cluster-networking stack.
  • Partner with ML researchers, data engineers, and hardware engineers to define requirements and make architectural decisions for large-scale training infrastructure.
  • Build custom kernels and benchmarks that track and validate performance gains across the stack.
  • Mentor engineers and raise the team’s technical bar through design reviews and best practices.
Qualifications
Note: You do not have to meet all the requirements below to be considered for this position:
  • 7+ years of total experience, including 4+ years on large-scale model training platforms, with a record of leading projects end to end.
  • Deep experience with distributed training frameworks (Megatron-LM, TorchTitan) and efficiently utilizing GPU/accelerator clusters at scale.
  • Experience with RL frameworks (Verl/MILES) and algorithms (GRPO, PPO).
  • Experience with collective communication libraries (e.g., NCCL) and optimizing communication/compute overlap in multi-node training.
  • Strong command of profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, or XLA/JAX profiling) to find and resolve training bottlenecks.
  • Proficiency in Python or C++.
  • Experience with ML compilers, performance tooling, or hardware/software co-design (GPU/TPU/accelerator architectures).
  • Ability to influence across teams and communicate technical tradeoffs to both researchers and engineers.

description:

bpx energy, a major oil and gas producer in the United States, leverages its expertise in unconventional gas, including shale, to deliver hydrocarbon production and technical knowledge worldwide. With operations in Texas and Louisiana, our US onshore business has become both a premier oil and gas producer and a leader in reducing methane emissions.
As part of BP, a global industry leader, we foster a high-energy, high-intensity environment built on
accountability, collegiality, innovation, and empowerment. At bpx, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment where safety, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and teamwork are valued.
Discover your place with us and help our business meet the challenges of reimagining and reinventing the future of energy.
Plant Technician
BPX Midstream
ROLE SYNOPSIS:
The Plant Technician is responsible for the safe, environmentally conscious, and economical operation of plant facilities, utilities, and equipment used to produce or refine oil and gas. This role operates plant inlet,
compression, process areas, and associated systems while supporting reliable production, maintenance readiness, process safety, and emergency response.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
• Operate facilities safely, economically, and with environmental awareness.
• Ensure safe working conditions and compliance with all safety and environmental
practices and procedures.
• Develop and execute energy isolation plans for maintenance activities.
• Use the verification application to verify critical work and document failures.
• Operate plant inlet, compression, process areas, and associated systems.
• Maximize production by meeting product specifications, supporting maximum facility runtime, and collaborating effectively with other disciplines and teams.
• Provide positive leadership while contributing as a team player.
• Complete daily read-ups and follow up on parameters outside normal operating ranges.
• Troubleshoot operational and maintenance problems.
• Perform routine housekeeping of the plant and process areas.
• Share knowledge with coworkers and support personal and company business goals and objectives.
• Interface with Maintenance, Production teams, gas distribution companies, and other parts of the BPX organization.
• Identify required maintenance on plant equipment and related systems and
complete computerized work orders.
• Prepare plant equipment and piping systems for maintenance.
• Use available training resources to strengthen technical capabilities.
• Maintain required operator training, emergency preparedness skills, and the
knowledge needed to assist with plant emergencies.
• Use hand tools, climb ladders and stairs to process-vessel elevations, open and close process valves, and operate motor vehicles.
• Take an active role in the Process Safety Management program and DOT pipeline compliance.
ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• At least five years of experience in oil and gas operations or a related industry.
• Proficiency with mechanical equipment and automation or instrumentation
systems.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Personal commitment to safety and environmental awareness.
• Understanding of process safety concepts and their application.
• Ability to read and use piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and process flow diagrams (PFDs).
• Willingness and ability to work the assigned 12-hour, 7-on/7-off shift schedule.
• Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and reporting functions.
• Valid driver's license.

• Location: Hawkville Central CDP

• Lift 30 lbs with two hands from floor to crown height twice, with 12-second rest intervals between lifts.

• Push horizontally with both hands positioned between waist and mid-chest height to generate a peak force of 120 lbs, three times.
• Pull horizontally with both hands positioned between waist and mid-chest height to generate a peak force of 120 lbs, three times.

• Carry 72 lbs with two hands at a self-selected height for 10 feet, twice, at a self selected pace.
• Carry at least 50 lbs with one hand for a minimum distance of 50 feet.
Stair and Ladder Climbing Abilities
• Climb up and down a total of 40 steps at a self-selected pace.
• Climb up and down 14 ladder rungs at a self-selected pace.
Agilities

touches to each side at a self-selected pace. Reach toward the toes on the
opposite side as far as possible; touching the toes is not required.
